slots.notes: Looping preview clip filling each of the three collection cards' media wells in the responsive 1->2->3 column grid. Each sits inside a 'liquid-glass rounded-[32px] p-[18px]' outer card and a 'relative rounded-[24px] overflow-hidden pb-[75%]' inner box (the 75% padding-bottom locks a 4:3 ratio), rendered as <video autoPlay loop muted playsInline className='absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover'> with a <source type='video/mp4'>. Three sockets in order, each paired with its own 'RARITY SCORE' value string in the glass info bar below. Muted autoplaying loops on a dark #010828 page, so supply short seamless silent loops with no audio dependency.

Display/heading typeface (natively 'Anton', mapped to Tailwind font-grotesk) carrying every uppercase heading: the 'Collection of ... objects' h2 (text-[32px]->[60px], font-normal uppercase, leading-[1.05]->1), the 'SEE / ALL / CREATORS' button stack (text-[32px]->[60px] and text-[20px]->[36px]), and both info-bar lines ('RARITY SCORE:' label at text-[14px] uppercase and the score value at text-[20px]). Loaded via Google Fonts in index.html and wired as font-grotesk in tailwind.config.js. Anton is a single-weight (400) condensed-geometric grotesque always set uppercase; a replacement must be a heavy display sans that holds the tight leading-[1]/leading-[0.9] line packing in all-caps without colliding.

Accent/script typeface (natively 'Condiment', mapped to Tailwind font-condiment) used for exactly one style-break word: 'Space' in the heading, rendered font-condiment text-neon (#6FFF00) at text-[36px]->[68px], font-normal normal-case — a cursive/handwritten flourish that deliberately interrupts the all-caps Anton run and is the only non-uppercase, only neon-colored word in the section. Loaded via Google Fonts in index.html. Replacement must be a casual cursive/script face that reads at large display sizes and contrasts hard against the condensed display sans; it inherits the neon accent color, so keep it legible as a single hero word.

Right-pointing chevron glyph rendered at w-[18px] h-[18px] inside each card's circular 48px 'liquid-glass rounded-full' action button (one icon type reused across all three cards), inheriting white (text-white, fg) via stroke='currentColor'. Native mark is an inline <svg> with a single rounded-cap rounded-join path d='M9 5l7 7-7 7' at strokeWidth 2.5 on a 0 0 24 24 viewBox, fill='none'; supply one single-color/currentColor stroked chevron.

mechanic: A dark space-navy (#010828) features section lays a flex header row (left: a two-line uppercase Anton heading whose middle word 'Space' breaks to neon-green cursive Condiment; right: a 'SEE ALL CREATORS' button with a neon underline bar) above a responsive 1->2->3 column grid of glassmorphism cards, each a 'liquid-glass' rounded-[32px] container holding a 4:3 autoplay-loop-muted video over a glass info bar (RARITY SCORE value + circular chevron button); the only motion is the looping videos plus hover scale/white-overlay transitions on the cards and buttons.
techDelivery: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS component spec (Tailwind custom colors cream/neon and font families font-grotesk/font-condiment in tailwind.config.js, a .liquid-glass component class in index.css, global bg #010828), with Anton + Condiment pulled from a Google Fonts <link> in index.html; no animation library and no external icon library — the chevron is an inline SVG and the cards/info bars are static markup mapped over a 3-item data array.
reskinNotes: The liquid-glass effect is metric- and palette-locked to the dark #010828 page: the .liquid-glass class hardcodes an rgba(255,255,255,0.01) luminosity-blended fill, a 4px backdrop-blur, an inset white highlight box-shadow and a 1.4px masked white gradient-border (the ::before linear-gradient 0.45->0.15->0->0.15->0.45 with -webkit-mask-composite xor) that only reads against a near-black background, so a reskin must keep a very dark bg or retune every rgba stop and the mask border. The palette is exposed only partially as tokens — 'cream' (#EFF4FF) and 'neon' (#6FFF00) are Tailwind custom colors and #010828 is a global, but cream/70 is written as a Tailwind opacity utility and the glass whites are raw rgba(255,255,255,*), so a non-monochrome-on-navy brand palette is a non-trivial swap. The heading is structurally special: 'Space' is a hardcoded style-break word (font-condiment + text-neon + normal-case) wrapped in an indented <span className='ml-12 sm:ml-24 md:ml-32'> whose left margin is hand-tuned to Anton metrics, so a brand with a different accent word or font width must re-tune the indent and may break the Anton/Condiment size pairing. All copy is hardcoded in JSX (the 'Collection of' / 'Space' / ' objects' heading fragments, 'SEE ALL CREATORS', the 'RARITY SCORE:' label and the three score strings '8.7/10' / '9/10' / '8.2/10'), and the three card video URLs point at d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net placeholder assets that must be replaced with brand clips. Note the template id 'orbis-cards' implies an orbit/image-ring, but the actual spec is a static 3-card video grid with no orbital or scroll motion.
